import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Set environment to suppress progress bars
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_DUMPIER"] = "0"
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_TRAIN"] = "0"

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from correct input path
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

id_col = "id"
target_col = "species"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]

# Get species column names from sample_submission to ensure correct order
species_cols = sample_submission.columns[1:]  # Skip 'id' column
n_species = len(species_cols)

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df[target_col].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test_df[id_col].copy()

# Encode labels using the species columns from sample_submission
species_to_idx = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(species_cols)}
y_train_encoded = y_train.map(species_to_idx).values

# Hold-out validation split (model never sees val during training)
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_encoded, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_encoded
)

# Train a single LGBM model with optimized parameters
params = {
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "n_estimators": 200,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "class_weight": "balanced",
}

model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

# Predict on validation set
val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_proba = np.clip(val_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_proba = val_proba / val_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Calculate individual model validation logloss
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba, labels=np.arange(n_species))
print(f"Model Validation Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Predict on test set using the same trained model
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)
test_proba = np.clip(test_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_proba = test_proba / test_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Create submission file with correct format at required path
submission_df = pd.DataFrame()
submission_df["id"] = test_ids

# Align prediction columns with sample_submission column order
for idx, col in enumerate(species_cols):
    submission_df[col] = test_proba[:, idx]

# Save submission to required path
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
